description: This PHP class defines the AWS SageMakerGeospatialClient, a client used to interact with Amazon SageMaker's geospatial capabilities. It includes method annotations for various operations such as managing earth observation jobs, vector enrichment jobs, and data collections, serving as an SDK wrapper for AWS services related to geospatial data processing.

classes.name: SageMakerGeospatialClient
classes.description: A client class for interacting with AWS SageMaker geospatial services, providing methods for various geospatial data operations.
